FORMAL REVIEW — APPROVE cand-6PWGT8E20WC66VGFSH31J1F18R, exact f726accca708f5373f002d1207de794ba76cfc35 over 3a17912c1b1115562f4c7327103b62c17fa665cb.

Scope is exactly one new 60-line test path, interview/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/probes/PlacementResolutionRemedySuite.scala. git diff --check is clean. The reviewed exact-archive file hashes to blob 9918d0428608c7997d1eb47603ebc3240744eda4, identical to the candidate blob.

Independent exact-archive evidence with isolated sbt/Coursier state and the pinned local grakern build:
- focused PlacementResolutionRemedySuite: 1/1 passed;
- full interviewJVM/test: 104/104 passed;
- interviewJVM/scalafmtCheckAll: passed.
The archive has no .git metadata, so build-version probes printed expected fatal not-a-git-repository diagnostics; task exit and counted test/format results were clean.

The negative is not vacuous. The suite first proves type visibility, a genuinely absent type, and successful Mirror.ProductOf summoning for the known case class DetailAssessment. I then mutated only the question target from PlacementResolution to DetailAssessment; the suite failed at the exact Mirror assertion, 1/1 failed. Restored bytes rehash to the candidate blob.

Disposition: the plain final class plus private constructor remedy still defeats external Mirror.ProductOf derivation in Scala 3.7.4, and the companion exposes no fromProduct path. This approves the positive-control receipt only. It does not authorize or certify the four align/cost.scala repairs, which remain separate work and must flip the existing known-bad structural courts deliberately.
